description: The source describes raw, unprocessed CSV outputs from fixed-base simulator studies using STISIM Drive 3. Experimental drives test low-cost road-safety interventions in vulnerable-road-user, school-zone, rural and urban scenarios. The logged measures include vehicle speed, lateral position and other dynamic variables. This provides behavioural simulation observations, with no claim that the records are real traffic trajectories. The metadata do not state participant numbers, geographic scenarios, observation dates, sample rate or the full variable list. Access is restricted and file descriptors are absent, so completeness and internal organization remain source claims that were not checked against files. The named source creators provide this metadata through Zenodo, whose deposits declare CC BY 4.0. Access restrictions and underlying provider terms remain separate from that declaration; cost is unknown unless explicitly stated. Geographic and temporal coverage are limited to the source-described roads, scenarios or periods. Metadata only was reviewed, with no files, measurements, imagery, archives or document bodies downloaded. Related components retain their distinct native identities and possible overlap. The described physical assets, observations or simulator outputs support road infrastructure simulation within these stated limits.
